import json, re, sys
from docx import Document
from docx.table import Table
from docx.text.paragraph import Paragraph
from docx.oxml.ns import qn

P = r"E:\TTQS\_github_sync_0064\docs\ttqs-quality-20261016\quality-review\0085_R01\candidate\0085_R06.docx"
doc = Document(P)

# ordered body elements
def iter_block_items(parent):
    from docx.oxml.table import CT_Tbl
    from docx.oxml.text.paragraph import CT_P
    parent_elm = parent.element.body
    for child in parent_elm.iterchildren():
        if isinstance(child, CT_P):
            yield Paragraph(child, parent)
        elif isinstance(child, CT_Tbl):
            yield Table(child, parent)

blocks = []
for b in iter_block_items(doc):
    if isinstance(b, Paragraph):
        blocks.append(("P", b.text))
    else:
        rows = []
        for r in b.rows:
            rows.append([c.text for c in r.cells])
        blocks.append(("T", rows))

print("N_BLOCKS", len(blocks))
print("N_TABLES", sum(1 for k,v in blocks if k=="T"))
print("N_PARAS", sum(1 for k,v in blocks if k=="P"))
print("SECTIONS", len(doc.sections))
print("TABLE_DIMS", [ (len(v), max((len(r) for r in v), default=0)) for k,v in blocks if k=="T" ])

# print table headers with index and first row
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(blocks):
    if k=="T":
        first = v[0] if v else []
        print("TBL", i, "rows", len(v), "cols", max((len(r) for r in v), default=0), "HDR", " | ".join(first)[:160])
